result:
Everything checks out — typecheck and the full test suite pass.

I made `GET /health` actually probe the database instead of returning a static `{status:"ok"}`. New file `app/Http/HealthCheck.ts` exports `getHealth()`, which runs a `select 1` round trip against the app's real Drizzle/SQLite connection (via `config/database.ts`'s `getDatabase()`), returning `{httpStatus: 200, body: {status:"ok", checks:{db:{status:"ok"}}}}` on success or `{httpStatus: 503, body: {status:"error", checks:{db:{status:"error", message}}}}` if the query throws; the database probe is injectable so it's unit-testable without a live connection. `routes/web.ts` now awaits `getHealth()` and writes the resulting body/status via `c.json(body, httpStatus)`, keeping the route unauthenticated and still exempt from host authorization. Added `tests/HealthCheck.test.ts` (unit tests for the ok/error branches of `getHealth`) and extended the existing `/health` HTTP test in `tests/HomeController.test.ts` to assert the new JSON shape.
